{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates (REST-interface.md and release notes) merely accompany the code change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation is not the primary change; the documentation edits document the new txindex and REST pruning behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies txindex logic (src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h) to allow concurrent operation with block pruning.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Allows running -txindex concurrently with block pruning, addressing multiple long-standing feature requests (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). As noted by contributors, having txindex retain all transaction metadata on pruned nodes significantly expands pruned node capabilities for transaction lookups and proof generation without requiring a full unpruned chain."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies RPC and REST endpoints (src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp, src/rest.cpp) and adds structured error data support in src/rpc/request.*.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends JSON-RPC error reporting with candidate block hashes when target blocks are pruned. Commands like getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof, and REST /tx provide structured error responses that enable callers to fetch missing blocks via getblockfrompeer."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test additions are subsystem-specific functional and unit tests for txindex pruning, not test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The functional and unit tests verify txindex pruning behavior and compatibility, which belong to the indexes area rather than test harness infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/init.cpp only adjust initialization checks for txindex and pruning arguments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Argument checks in init.cpp serve index subsystem configuration rather than general utility or startup infrastructure."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 3,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
